assumptions: A printed Health DR dash is treated as zero for this experiment.
Karma, Focus attacks and noncombat abilities are not used.
Table literal Marvel damage pools replace the printed Core damage formula.
The separate Fast Hands reaction can only pay a Ranged Weapons power.
Point-Blank Parry does not target an unconscious attacker in this host.
Stopping Power does not follow up against an unconscious target in this host.
The grapple host restricts actors in a hold to escape, release or wait.
Carrying, attacking while holding and multiple simultaneous holds are not implemented.
Shield and escape trigger identity is an explicitly selected hypothesis.
